title: relay.put
description: Put a share into the mailbox of each member on a relay server, with the instance token kept for it (the manager app only; a shared vault's mailbox relay). Endpoint: admin; direction: a2s; phase C. Unknown members are ignored by the reader (protocol.md section 8).

relay.description: [C] A relay server the approval link may go through: tsm:<url>.

items.description: A member id: the fingerprint of the member key (base32).
